js.bash:
HEAD_SHA=abc123
BASE_REF=$(gh pr view 77 --repo acme/widgets --json baseRefName --jq .baseRefName 2>/dev/null || true)
mkdir -p "${TRIBUNAL_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/tribunal-data}"
case "$BASE_REF" in
  staging|production) IS_DEPLOY=1 ;;
  *) IS_DEPLOY=0 ;;
esac
if [ "$IS_DEPLOY" = "0" ]; then
TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
EPOCH=$(date +%s)
if [ -n "$HEAD_SHA" ]; then HS="\"$HEAD_SHA\""; else HS=null; fi
// windows-size: fixed one-line JSON, about 200 characters plus the repo name
cat <<STARTJSON >> "${TRIBUNAL_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/tribunal-data}/inflight-runs.jsonl"
{"event":"started","pr":77,"repo":"acme/widgets","headSha":$HS,"batchPanelsRequested":false,"ts":"$TS","epoch":$EPOCH}
STARTJSON
fi
